source: Publication rule. Recheck capacities, supported carveouts, cache controls, and product bandwidth against current architecture documentation before reusing this page in a future edition. Do not time-stamp the evergreen chapters merely because this snapshot is dated.
zh: 出版规则。在未来版本中重用此页面之前，根据当前架构文档重新检查容量、支持的分拆、缓存控制和产品带宽。不要仅仅因为此快照已过时就给常青章节添加时间戳。
